sn20.11:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave rattiyā paccusasamayaṃ siṅgālassa vassamānassāti || || Evam bhante || || Eso kho bhikkhave jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇṇakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho || So yena yena icchati tena tena gacchati || yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha tiṭṭhati || yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha nisīdati || yattha yattha icchati attha tattha nippajjati || sītako pi naṃ vāto upavāyati || || Sādhu khvassa bhikkhave yam idhekacco sakyaputtiyapatiñño evarūpaṃ pi attabhāvapatilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha || || Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || || Appamattā viharissāmāti || || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Ekādasamaṃ || ||
